name: Crownfield
description: A protected farming heartland where new adventurers learn town routes, meadow threats, and basic field work.

name: Mossvale
description: A damp woodland of mossy ruins, old shrines, and ambush paths beneath the canopy.

name: Amber Dunes
description: A sunlit desert route where caravan trails cross glassy sands and buried vaults.

name: Blueharbor Coast
description: A salt-air coastline of docks, tide caves, and weather-beaten lighthouse roads.

name: Ironroot Highlands
description: A rugged upland of mineral roots, steep trails, and fortified mining camps.

name: Moonveil Marsh
description: A moonlit wetland where fog hides witchlights, sink paths, and poisonous pools.

name: Starfall Tower
description: A sky-piercing arcane tower built around a fallen star and the campaign's final ascent.
